description: Rename one vendor attribute key on a DRAFT price book, rewriting and rehashing every price break that carries it. This is optional schema cleanup; it does NOT bind the attribute to an item field. Use map_price_book_attribute for the authoritative canonical field and option mapping. Draft only — activation freezes keys because saved sourcing profiles and break hashes then depend on them.

fromKey.description: The attribute key as the book currently spells it.

toKey.description: The replacement vendor-side machine key. This does not create a canonical mapping.

name: adopt_price_book_attribute_key
title: Rename Price Book Attribute
